domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with regrouping and simplification

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard quantity into an equivalent standard form before subtraction, including normalizing improper fractional parts in mixed numbers and representing a whole number with a zero fractional part when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is rewritten as a standard mixed number.
Tag when a fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator to enable componentwise subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for converting one or both fractions to equivalent fractions solely to create a common denominator; that is S02.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun; that is S05.
Do not tag when no explicit representational rewrite is performed.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions with a shared denominator.
Tag in mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already compatible and no conversion or explicit denominator-alignment step is shown.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as having 0 over a denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction; that is S06.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are in compatible form, including like fractions and the fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators of like-denominator fractions are subtracted.
Tag when the fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag whether the fractional result is positive, zero, or negative before any regrouping adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for creating a common denominator; that is S02.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number components; that is S04.
Do not tag for the borrowing or regrouping step itself; that is S05.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the quantities, including whole parts of mixed numbers and subtraction against an implied whole part of zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 minus 2.
Tag when a mixed number is subtracted from a whole number or fraction and the other quantity has an implied whole part of 0.
Tag whether whole-part subtraction is done before or alongside fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number components.
Do not tag for borrowing one whole from the whole part; that is S05.
Do not tag for final recombination of whole and fractional results; that is S06.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part is too small to subtract directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step reduces the whole part by 1 and converts that whole into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after or in anticipation of a negative fractional difference.
Tag when the borrowed whole is added to the existing fractional part before re-subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is S01.
Do not tag when no regrouping from the whole part occurs.
Do not tag for ordinary whole-part or fraction-part subtraction that does not involve borrowing.

skills.name: Compose and simplify result
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts into the final answer and reduce the result to lowest terms, integer form, or zero when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step combines a whole part and a fraction part into a mixed number or final fraction.
Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fractional part is collapsed to an integer or 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction operations themselves; those are S03 and S04.
Do not tag for normalization before subtraction; that is S01.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping; that is S05.
